lines: Hazaron khwahishen aisi ki har khwahish pe dam nikle
couplets.en: A thousand desires, each enough to take my last breath.

lines: Bahut nikle mere armaan lekin phir bhi kam nikle
couplets.en: So many of my longings came true, and still too few.

lines: Nikalna khuld se Aadam ka sunte aaye hain lekin
couplets.en: We have long heard how Adam was driven from paradise.

lines: Bahut be-aabru ho kar tere kooche se hum nikle
couplets.en: I left your street in deeper disgrace.

lines: Mohabbat mein nahin hai farq jeene aur marne ka
couplets.en: In love, living and dying are much the same.

lines: Usi ko dekh kar jeete hain jis kaafir pe dam nikle
couplets.en: I live by the sight of the faithless one for whom I would die.

lines: Hazaron khwahishen aisi ki har khwahish pe dam nikle
couplets.en: A thousand desires, each enough to take my last breath.

lines: Bahut nikle mere armaan lekin phir bhi kam nikle
couplets.en: So many of my longings came true, and still too few.

lines: Khuda ke vaaste parda na Kaabe se utha, zaalim
couplets.en: For God's sake, you cruel one, leave the veil upon the Kaaba.

lines: Kahin aisa na ho yahaan bhi vahi kaafir sanam nikle
couplets.en: The same faithless beloved might turn up here too.

lines: Kahaan mai-khaane ka darwaaza, Ghalib, aur kahaan waaiz
couplets.en: What business has the preacher at the tavern door, Ghalib?

lines: Par itna jaante hain kal vo jaata tha ki hum nikle
couplets.en: All I know is that yesterday he was going in as I came out.
